old: In Utazás a koponyám körül, Karinthy demonstrates that rigorous syntax is not cold pedantry—it is an instrument of intellectual sovereignty. By turning his own symptoms into variables ('attól függően, hogy...', 'minél tárgyilagosabban..., annál kevésbé...'), language itself masters fear.
new: The story you read in this lesson is adapted from Karinthy's book Utazás a koponyám körül; its sentences are written for learners, not Karinthy's own words.
